github._comment: Official GitHub MCP server (remote streamable-http, no Docker required). Manages issues, PRs, actions on aphrody-code/{aphrody,n2b,bxc,ui,next.js}. Token resolved from env at runtime — set GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN in your shell (e.g. ~/.bashrc or .env loaded before claude). Required scopes: repo, workflow, read:org. Reuse the gh CLI token: GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN=$(gh auth token).
